fields.summary_ko.0: Alphabet (NASDAQ: GOOGL) stock price has fallen near $285–$290, forming a $300 resistance line, with profitability concerns from approximately $20 billion in infrastructure spending and an additional $10 billion Anthropic investment acting as downward pressure.
fields.summary_ko.1: Despite the launch of the new Gemini 4 Hydrogen model (Terminal-Bench 4.1 score 57%) and pre-order commencement for smart glasses ($395–$449) in partnership with Samsung and Warby Parker, investor skepticism has grown about whether massive capital expenditures can translate into sufficient profit generation.
